_description: Defects found in Cartography, each with the evidence that lets its team reproduce it. An entry is added only after a person has verified it (a static-check lead in the report is not yet a finding). Status: open, reported (with the issue URL), fixed-upstream.

findings.summary: RouteTableToVpnGatewayRel targets AWSVpnGateway, which no schema defines, so the CONNECTED_TO edge from a route table to a VPN gateway can never materialise.
findings.evidence: cartography/models/aws/ec2/route_tables.py lines 117-123: '# TODO implement AWSVpnGateways' and 'No edge can materialize until AWSVpnGateway nodes are implemented.' Cartography documents this itself, so it is a known gap rather than a bug to report; recorded so the lead is not raised again.
